Weakness: Absence of multi-factor authentication and credential hygiene across staff accounts
Threat: Stolen or brute-forced staff credentials leading to credential stuffing
Impact: Data breach of customer PII and privacy exposure

Weakness: Overly permissive cloud storage sharing defaults and lack of link restrictions
Threat: Accidental public link sharing or unauthorized export distribution
Impact: Unauthorized disclosure of customer order records and PII

Weakness: Lack of formal change review workflow and unsegregated administrative access
Threat: Unreviewed or unauthorized configuration changes introduced directly to production store
Impact: Operational disruption, downtime, and configuration errors

Weakness: Unrestricted warehouse record editing and absence of transaction audit logging
Threat: Unrestricted warehouse edits without verification leading to inventory drift
Impact: Stock discrepancy, fulfillment failure, and financial inaccuracy

Weakness: Absence of segregation of duties in refund handling and single-user approval authority
Threat: Single staff member requesting and approving fraudulent or erroneous refunds
Impact: Financial loss and unauthorized payout leakage

Weakness: Connected backup repositories without cryptographic isolation or tested recovery verification
Threat: Ransomware infection or malicious deletion spreading to backup storage
Impact: Extended operational outage and permanent data loss

Weakness: Inadequate data minimization and unencrypted mobile transmission of recipient details
Threat: Lost mobile device or unencrypted file exposure during courier handoff
Impact: Customer privacy breach and regulatory non-compliance

Weakness: Lack of security awareness training and susceptibility to phishing tricks
Threat: Phishing emails tricking staff into revealing credentials and session tokens
Impact: Account compromise and unauthorized internal access
Proposed Control: Staff awareness training + MFA + quick reporting
